changes.title: Creature size range
items: Small animals are easier to see, babies and youngsters are more distinct, and the largest adults have more room to grow. Legends are larger than their own adults without towering so far above them.

changes.title: Heat refraction preview
items: An optional refraction preview adds campfire heat and a short party-spell pressure wave; it stays off unless enabled in the link.

changes.title: Stiltwalkers potion
items: Stiltwalkers replaces Tall Tales: familiar animal bodies ride high on long legs that taper to tiny feet.
